translations.Das persönliche Kürzel wird beim MTV-Ver: The personal short form is used in the MTV note (“mail sent”) in shift comments. It must be unique (case is ignored), may contain at most 4 characters (letters and dot). Default: first two letters of the surname, otherwise initials (1st letter of first name + 1st letter of surname). If the desired short form is already taken, free suggestions are offered.
translations.Der Bürotag beginnt um diese Uhrzeit (St: The office day starts at this time (default 06:00 in the instance time zone from the Nextcloud settings). Shifts ending before this time are no longer shown in the overview, search sheet and mail; shifts of the current office day remain visible until the next start of the office day. Leave empty to reset to the default 06:00.

translations.Nur Assistentinnen des Teams werden gefü: Only assistants of the team are listed; yes/no is booked per open shift, tel/SMS count as general reachability for all open shifts. The info icon per AS opens the overlay on click (initially read-only; hover shows the info: day only / night only / early only / late only + free text); the pencil button in the overlay unlocks editing; the comment field saves internal notes directly on the AS user.
